about: The Java the art tools run FFDec under (tools/java.mjs for Node, tools/java_path.py for Python, both read this file): $GRODDLE_JAVA when set, else the first Homebrew JDK found in this order, else plain java on the PATH. openjdk@21 was the only one until a Homebrew upgrade removed it (2026-11); FFDec runs under 17, 25 and 27 too.
